page.overview:
What is Adventure Funtime Foxy?

Adventure Funtime Foxy belongs to Five Nights at Freddy's. is an unlockable character in FNaF World, and the intact version of Adventure Mangle.

Funtime Foxy is a fox animatronic with the majority of its fur colored white. It has a pink snout with a small black nose, three small fluffs of fur on top of its head, pink toes and stomach, pink markings inside its ears and around its eyes and midriff, and at the tip of the tail. It has bright red cheeks and red lipstick on its snout, long eyelashes, a red bow tie, and wears a hook on its right hand.
